result:
I repaired both findings (F-DG2-210 and F-DG2-211). Every required check ran and passed, except `pnpm format:check`: it fails only because the sandbox hides 12 untracked dotfiles from it, and the variant that skips them passes. The changes are uncommitted on top of `HEAD` `190504171b…`. The handback is at `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE5-frontend-ux-engineer.md`.

**F-DG2-210 (blank text in forms).** The charter form is built on the same component as the other record forms (`RecordForm.tsx`), so one fix covers both.
- Text is now sent exactly as typed. Only a truly empty field becomes `null`, which on edit clears a value that was there.
- Text made only of spaces or invisible characters is now an inline error with the existing English/Arabic `validation__blank` message. The field is marked invalid and linked to the message, focus moves to the first invalid field, and nothing is sent. The check uses the shared `hasText()`, the same rule the server uses.
- The charter's change summary is now marked as describing a change rather than being one. A save where only the summary changed shows "There are no changes to save." and writes no empty new version.
- I added 10 component tests in EN and AR. Seven of them fail when I swap the original code back in, and all pass with the fix.
- A new end-to-end spec, `apps/web/e2e/p2-blank-text.spec.ts`, runs on the real stack in both languages. It confirms three things:
  - a whitespace Case for change creates no charter;
  - a whitespace Out of scope writes no version and keeps the existing value;
  - a whitespace T01 Current state sends nothing.

**F-DG2-211 (error banner breaks list semantics).** The alert role is now on a wrapper around a normal list. A search of `apps/web/src` found no other alert or status role on a list. The end-to-end spec opens the error banner and runs axe on it in EN and AR: 0 violations of any severity.

**Checks:**

| Check | Result |
|---|---|
| typecheck, build, lint | exit 0 |
| `pnpm format:check` | exit 2, only on the 12 hidden dotfiles; the variant that skips them exits 0 |
| `pnpm test` on Node 22 and on Node 24 | 568/568 each |
| contrast check | passes |
| end-to-end: P1 + P2 journeys + new spec, chromium-en and chromium-ar | 50/50 pass; axe found 0 serious or critical issues across all 45 P2 scans per language |
| DG1 historical validator | PASS |

I looked at two screenshots: the English charter form with the error banner, and the Arabic (right-to-left) T01 dialog with the inline message. Both are in `docs/delivery/handbacks/DG2/T-DG2-FE5-evidence/`; the other six screenshots were not kept.

**Gaps:**
- I didn't re-run the new browser test against the original code. So the proof that the old banner fails axe in this exact state comes from QA's round-3 evidence, not from my own run.
- Three hand-written forms outside RecordForm still trim text before sending: the gate submission note, decision rationale and comments, the journey steps, and the row-action note. The assignment didn't name them, so I left them for a follow-up if reviewers want the same rule there.

I authored these fixes, so I don't close the findings.
